# Feature: Connection Core (Integration Core Step 01)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-11-04 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Minimal Integration Core: Provider catalog, multi-account Connections with encrypted credentials,
structured Capability resolution, Module Bindings, sync-cursor stubs, and a Mock adapter with
contract tests — without Inbox UI or real Gmail/Telegram yet.
Roadmap: Inbox P0 (Stufe A) — Integration Core foundation

## Preconditions
- API + Postgres runnable; business membership exists
- Owner/Admin (or superadmin) may mutate connections
- `settings_secrets` remains untouched for Metricool/Brevo/Ads keys

## Happy Path
- [ ] Migration creates `connections`, `connection_credentials`, `module_bindings`, `sync_cursors` (tenant = business_id)
- [ ] Mock adapter can connect → resolve structured capabilities → bind module purpose → list bindings via API
- [ ] Credential ciphertext is stored encrypted; API never returns plaintext tokens
- [ ] Capability resolver returns structured fields (scopes, accountType, formats, windows, availability) — not only booleans
- [ ] Contract tests: mock connect/capabilities/bind; cross-tenant connection access returns 404/403
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict)

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Second connection same provider+external id is rejected (unique)
- [ ] Viewer cannot create/update connections
- [ ] Binding to unknown connection / wrong business fails closed
- [ ] Invalid capability purpose or module enum rejected (Zod)
- [ ] Disabled binding is excluded from “active” resolve paths

## Regression
- [ ] Existing Settings secrets / Metricool / Brevo / Ads flows unchanged
- [ ] CRM / Projects / task Inbox page still loads

## Assumptions
- Providers are a code registry (not a DB `providers` table) for V1
- Step 01 exposes API + tests only; Settings UI for connections deferred to channel E2E ticket
- Outbox job runner table deferred until first real send (step 02); sync_cursors table present for cursor contract
- Screenshots N/A (API/infra ticket) — verify via tests + typecheck
